fid.description: A UUID made by Encore (lowercase, as Python's str(uuid4())).

id.description: Catalog song id (= job id). A song Encore only found by scanning the folders has an 'f-...' id; the Studio may match it by base.

base.description: The version played (the song's own base or a version's).

t.description: Video time of that version, seconds; null = the whole song (flagged afterwards from Last songs).

line.description: The words.json line's 'i' (1-based) at t; null when unknown or for the whole song.

party.description: The party name, for the Studio's mark text 'Encore: <kind> (<by>, <party>)'.

uid.description: Optional, for user profiles (§2.6, planned): the profile uuid of the person, when a user (not a guest) did it.
